record_contract.exactly_one_rule: unresolved_ambiguity_instances has length exactly one; its ambiguity_type is one non-empty scalar string and its resolution_status is unresolved
record_contract.no_secondary_rule: secondary_ambiguity_instances is an empty list and every eligibility assertion is true
record_contract.adjudication_rule: annotation_status is adjudicated; two distinct blind reviewer assignments and a final adjudication are required

exclusion_ledger_contract.future_source_rule: T42 cannot freeze until T41 and T44 source ledgers are available and every comparator is no_overlap.

frozen_manifest_requirements.fixed_inference_configuration: must name already-fixed system identities and byte hashes; it cannot be used to select or tune systems

analysis_contract.eligible_strata: report support-qualified strata and label smaller strata count-only
analysis_contract.uncertainty_scope: limited to this independently frozen corpus and eligible strata
analysis_contract.safety_limitation: single-ambiguity evidence does not establish compound-ambiguity, causal-context, or generalisation claims

current_state.blocker: No independently licensed source corpus, blind annotations/adjudication, or T41/T44 comparison ledgers have been supplied.
